name: Shinozaki Aori
source:
One of the new participants.

She comes off to others as being rather emotionless and aloof because she is always making judgments and decisions based on facts and logic. Social situations are difficult for her to read (though she's trying), and she has a deep interest in getting to know the workings of the human heart.

[Edited from [url=https://wolf-game.fandom.com/wiki/Aori_Shinozaki]Wolf Game Wiki[/url]]
